items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: But this King, it was just something about that that, I don’t know just Cannonball sounded great on this. And Charlie Parker sounded great on this horn.

ctx.x: Isn’t that something, because I did too. And so you really do know. Because that’s a subtle thing, but it is a difference. And I remember it as a CD or record, whatever, where he did play Selmer for a while. And it was great, and it’s still great ‘cause he’s great. And I remember that oh this is great, but it was like, you know it doesn’t have that pop, or that warmth either. Because there was something — but it’s still great. And the Selmer is a great horn you know, and he sounded great on it. But this King, it…
No. You grow into an instrument and—
